system.name: MAPF-GPT
system.one_liner: A transformer trained by pure imitation learning on a billion expert observation-action pairs to choose actions for multi-agent pathfinding without heuristics or communication.

content.variant_note: four titled dashed stage frames in a 2x2 grid, read clockwise from the bottom right: scenarios, expert solutions, tokenised observation-action pairs, training loop; dataset sizes printed in cylinders
content.argues: MAPF-GPT is learned from an expert: scenarios are solved by LaCAM, solutions become about 1B tokenised observation-action pairs, and a transformer is trained on them with cross-entropy.
content.subject: the four-step learning pipeline of MAPF-GPT, from maps to a trained model, with the data size after each step

lessons.what_to_learn: Print the dataset size inside a cylinder at every stage of a data pipeline and give each stage a coloured dashed frame with a numbered title, so order and funnel read at a glance. Dots in a label repeated at the arrow starts show which half of a pair each arrow carries.
lessons.suits: Data-construction plus training pipelines (imitation, distillation, synthetic data) where dataset sizes and an expert tool are central.

Generating ground truth data, i.e. MAPF solutions using an expert solver.

summary: MAPF-GPT learns multi-agent pathfinding by imitating an expert: no heuristics, no communication. Figure 1 shows the four learning steps as four dashed, numbered frames in a 2x2 grid that the flow traverses clockwise from the bottom right. POGEMA turns 10k maze and 2.5k random maps into 3.75M problem instances; the LaCAM expert solves them into 85M ground-truth trajectories; local observations are cut out of a map and tokenised into red and teal token groups, then filtered into a 1B-pair dataset; mini-batches of these pairs train the MAPF-GPT box with a cross-entropy loss on the ground-truth actions. Dataset sizes are printed in large type inside colour-coded cylinders.
summary_zh: MAPF-GPT 用模仿学习训练多智能体寻路。图用四个带编号的虚线框按顺时针排列：地图生成实例、LaCAM 求出 85M 条轨迹、观测切成两组 token 并过滤成 1B 对数据、再训练模型；各阶段的数据量直接写在彩色圆柱里。
notes: Panels: the four dashed, titled frames are counted as panels (the index says one panel; the prior labels said four). The red versus teal token colours and what the two coloured agents on the map stand for are not explained, so the relations from agent to token group are described only as drawn.
